evidence: deepseek-v4-flash uses `p1_list[i] + p2_list[i] > T` and `sum(p1_list) > T`; gpt-oss-120b uses `p1 + p2 > T`, `sum1 > T`, and `sum2 > T`; glm-5 comments `LOAD 1: p2 all zero, T_j = sum of all p1`.
affordance_in_statement: There is a job i ... every other job k != i is instantaneous (replaced with p_{1,k} = 0 and p_{2,k} = 0); and: if c = 1 ... p_{2,k} = 0 for all k, while if c = 2 ... p_{1,k} = 0 ...
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving removal: under the given recurrence, the isolated-job witness is necessarily p_{1,i}+p_{2,i}, and the load witnesses are necessarily the corresponding sums. Re-presenting the simulations may obscure the shortcut but cannot eliminate it without changing the task.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Algebraically evaluates an isolated job as p1+p2 and each machine-saturation case as a total sum.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: every other job ... is instantaneous; the other machine takes 0 time for all jobs

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Computes the three closed-form witness conditions in one pass and relies on the exclusive-family guarantee.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: exactly one of the two failure families is guaranteed to hold

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses total p1 or total p2 for LOAD witnesses and the isolated-job p1+p2 condition.

common_affordance: The explicitly zeroed hypothetical simulations, whose recurrence reduces an isolated job to p1_i+p2_i and a saturated machine to a sum of processing times.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It explicitly simulates every isolated-job hypothetical sequence for every job, producing O(j^2) time and timing out at j = 200000 instead of using the closed form.

recommended_edit: No single semantics-preserving edit can defeat all survivors: this is an intrinsic algebraic consequence of the required zero-time hypothetical scenarios. Defeating them would require changing the witness scenarios or the recurrence so that other jobs contribute nonzero interaction costs.
